title.th: English Quest · 1,000 บทเรียน
title.lo: English Quest · 1,000 ບົດຮຽນ

description: Original lesson content informed by language-learning pedagogy, practical course design, grammar scope and CEFR descriptors. Nine spaced retrieval sessions revisit each of the 100 core lessons with a distinct skill focus. Not copied from the books.
designPrinciples: Across the course, balance understandable input, focused language study, meaningful output and fluency practice.
Each lesson has a practical CEFR-inspired can-do goal and a short, finishable task.
Core phrases and vocabulary return in spaced retrieval sessions with different listening, reading, speaking, writing and fluency goals.
Grammar scope progresses from everyday A1 forms through routine A2 communication to connected B1 language.

sources.title: Paul Nation, What you need to know to learn a foreign language
sources.use: Short, repeatable work across listening, speaking, reading, writing, vocabulary and grammar; retrieved practice; learner autonomy.

sources.title: Paul Nation, What should every ESL teacher know?
sources.use: Teacher-facing principles for balancing language input, deliberate study, output, fluency and learning support.

sources.title: Paul Nation, The Four Strands of a Language Course
sources.use: Balanced meaning-focused input, language-focused learning, meaning-focused output and fluency practice.

sources.title: Oxford English File Fifth Edition Beginner
sources.use: A practical sequence that connects grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation and the four skills in familiar contexts.

sources.title: Raymond Murphy, Essential Grammar in Use Fourth Edition
sources.use: A1–B1 grammar scope, short explanations and practice items; topics are paraphrased and independently written.

sources.title: Council of Europe, CEFR Companion Volume (2020)
sources.use: Level progression and practical can-do outcomes for reception, interaction and production.

levels.canDo: Handle familiar everyday expressions and simple personal information.
Communicate in routine tasks and talk about familiar needs and experiences.
Produce connected language on familiar topics and briefly explain opinions and plans.
